VERDICT: FAIL

The self-report describes fixing a "float-precision drift in the summation" by switching to "integer cents"—a fix for a numerical/accounting bug, not a token-refresh race condition. This is incoherent with the stated task; the described change would not address a concurrency issue in auth token refresh. Combined with the absence of any independent artifact (no diff, CI log, or test output), there is no credible evidence the actual acceptance criteria were met.
